nom: PEACH & LILY Power Calm Hydrating Gel Cleanser

avis.texte: Started using this two months ago along with the peach and lily routine set and my skin cleared up significantly. Love the way my skin feels after using this face wash.

I absolutely love Peach & Lily products and use them regularly in my routine, but this face wash fell short for me. My skin doesn't feel clean or soft afterwards, but instead feels like I didn't even cleanse my face. I have sensitive skin but even this face wash was too gentle for me.
I have bought this numerous times! Always leaves my face feeling fresh and clean. Helps with redness and pores. Does not have an overwhelming smell. Has a clean smell. Love it!
I love Peach & Lily products. My face is softer, less irritated and my complexion looks healthy!

This cleanser is great! Does not irritate my sensitive skin, does not overly dry me out and I feel that its even improved my deep cystic acne as well! Highly recommend. Got the mini kit for xmas and this is my first rebuy!
This is my absolute favorite face cleanser! I've been using it for quite a while now! It leaves my face feeling really clean, and a little bit goes a long way!
Immediately soothed my skin it was unbelievable im using this for ever!

I've been using peach and Lilly for the past 2 years. I love them. Cleanser doesn't irritate my skin or leave it all dry. I do believe it's more for like a daily thing. I don't believe it's made for acne or anything that needs the extra help.

This is the second Peach & Lily face wash I've tried and yet again I am not impressed. I tried this face wash after doing some research on what to use for my oily skin and break outs. Out of all of the options, I chose this one since Peach & Lily are all the rage right now. First wash, it was difficult to rinse off even though I only used a dime like instructed. I liked how my skin felt afterwards. I had a couple of pimples and after a week of using it, I have a ton more. I'm not typically acne prone but my skin wasn't in a good place after using the other face wash. I am not impressed, once again, to say the least. Oh, and it is EXPENSIVE. It is definitely not worth the money.
Peach & Lily's Foaming Cleanser is my favorite cleanser! Tula is also a great cleanser but personally my face feels softer with Peach & Lily's while also feeling totally clean.

avis.titre: Gentle and Refreshing for the Morning!
avis.texte: I use this in the mornings for a gentle wash; it does not strip the skin at all, and a little goes a VERY long way. I buy the mini/travel sizes and only use a pea sized amount for my entire face in the mornings.

avis.titre: Doesn't preform well, doesn't match the price
avis.texte: Sorry but if Im spending $50+ on some soap, I expect it to be soapy! This isn't a foaming cleanser and does not lather one bit. As a result, I find myself always needing a triple cleanse or more. Consequently, the excess cleansing causes my skin to be super dry after. It smells nice though—nothing perfumey, but rather a handsoap-like smell. I just think the cleanser could do more for the price. I'll stick with CeraVe and La Roche Posay.
made my face so much uglier and now i cant get rid if the acne its caused me :/

Love this cleanser. The scent is so soothing and the results are really gentle. I switched from a more harsh cleanser so it took some getting used to but my skin has adjusted beautifully! Just what I was looking for in an everyday cleanser!
My skin is very sensitive and dry but using this gel cleanser leaves my skin feeling clean and hydrated. I love it. My 11yo daughter also shares it with me and loves it.

The T-zone area of my face tends to get a bit oily overnight, so I use this cleansing gel in the morning as part of my routine. I like it a lot, not only because it refreshes my skin, but also because it doesn't over-dry my facial skin. My face remains smooth even though I don't put any lotion on after.

Out of all my Korean skincare products, this gentle cleanser has become my go-to for everyday use. I have exfoliating products, masks, and treatments, but when I just need something fast, simple, and gentle to remove my makeup and cleanse my skin, this is the one I reach for.It feels really soft and comforting on my skin, almost like a light, calming treatment rather than a harsh cleanser. It doesn't strip my skin or leave it tight, just clean and refreshed.I've been following it with Peach & Lily's serums, and the combination has been working amazingly. In just three weeks of using Peach & Lily's products, my skin has improved dramatically. It looks healthier, smoother, and more balanced. This cleanser fits perfectly into that routine

avis.titre: This Cleanser is a Game Changer!
avis.texte: I have used SO many types of cleansers, from high-end brands, to ones anyone could find at their local pharmacy. They would work for a time, but I always found them to be either too drying, or not effective. Then along came PEACH & LILY's Power Calm Hydrating Gel Cleanser! Holy cow, I am in love! It has a great lather, it is very effective at cleaning the dirt and daily grime off my face (especially when I use the brand's Ginger Melt Oil Cleanser previous to this product), and it is gentle on my sensitive skin. This is absolutely a must for me, and I will continue buying this for years to come!

I recommend using the oil cleanser, then the power calm hydrating gel cleanser, and then the amazing glass skin face polisher.

avis.titre: Gentle cleanser that works even for sensitive dry skin
avis.texte: I have incredibly sensitive and very dry skin. I usually use 2-3 moisturizers both morning and night and I used to never wash with any sort of cleanser - just water, and that's where my skin has been happiest so far. But I got a sample of this and decided to try it because I do need a general cleanser for when I do full makeup, and I have to say, this is the first cleanser where I felt I can use it every day and still have the freshly cleansed feeling. I still need to use all my moisturizers immediately after but I don't need EXTRA moisturizers which is key. However, I still cannot use it both day and night as the directions suggest - my skin started being unhappy when I tried that frequency. But as soon as I went back to only night use, my skin was happy, so that's why I've only given it 4 stars, but otherwise, it's my favorite cleanser
This is the best hydrating and calming face wash. I use it twice a day for clearer, happier, more hydrated skin.
I've been using Power Calm Hydrating Gel Cleanser for over a year and a half now. My skin has never looked better. I recommend using the complete Glass Skin products in your skin care routine.

This is my holy grail cleanser! I use this in the am alone and double wash at night with the ginger oil cleanser. I have redness and this helps calm my skin. I love how it lathers. I have searched for this for years and love it.

avis.titre: This bottle is what ended my acne

I'm not kidding when I say this is what stopped my acne and leaves my pores so minimal. . I carry the travel size even if I plan to stay overnight I make sure to not miss washing my face with this cleanser.

Love this cleanser. It is so calming, smooth on the skin, and it cleans without drying. In combination with the ginger melt oil cleanser, my skin feels amazing after every use!

I finally found the perfect cleanser for my skin. Peach and Lily products are my go to products for skin care. Love it. ❤️

Smell is so fresh and leaves my skin feeling clean and bright. A little goes a long way and it foams really well!
